m638PreservedFacts.blocker: An existing project proposal session must reach a terminal state and be cleared before replacement.

readOnlyFindings.ordinaryScope: The save-ui-execute route uses the ordinary exact-project proposal-session namespace.
readOnlyFindings.replacementGuard: A valid existing session with a different batch ID is never replaced; history cannot be shortened or rewritten.
readOnlyFindings.clearGuard: Only a valid exact session whose current history status is terminal may be removed; the clear receipt declares projectContentWrite=false.
readOnlyFindings.nonterminalControls: The visible review surface can reject previewed sessions or cancel/mark stale previewed or approved sessions. Unknown-outcome requires an authoritative reread before recovery and cannot be cleared directly.
readOnlyFindings.sessionContents: The exact persisted session contents and status remain intentionally uninspected.
readOnlyFindings.projectBoundary: No session helper writes project content, native project files, Foundry, credentials, or player passwords.

selectedNextBoundary.kind: code-only dedicated save-ui-execute session namespace isolation
selectedNextBoundary.rationale: Because the ordinary session's identity/status are intentionally unknown, terminalizing or clearing it would be unsafe. A dedicated closed test namespace can isolate only future save-ui-execute fixture session state, preserving the ordinary session untouched and requiring a separate artifact/observation gate afterward.
prohibitions: No Foundry, provider, credential, repository, or player-password action
No Stage 11 acceptance or Stage 12 work
